proposition: The Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid existed by 2 Dhū l-Qaʿda 830 (25 August 1427); Melvin-Koushki asterisks the date as possibly transcription, so it is a terminus ad quem. The Majlis copy was made in Shiraz.

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue
mediation.note: date and place may be those of the copying
